title: HoneyBee: Data Recipes for Vision-Language Reasoners
authors_zh: Hritik Bansal、Devendra Singh Sachan、Kai-Wei Chang、Aditya Grover、Gargi Ghosh、Wen-tau Yih、Ramakanth Pasunuru
paper_type_zh: 视觉语言推理数据配方与开放数据发布
best_for_zh: 关注多模态 CoT、教师蒸馏、数据缩放实验、来源指针和许可审计的研究者
one_line: HoneyBee reports 2.480M caption-plus-solution and text-only SFT records built with Llama-4 Scout around 28K images and 350K questions; the live release is pointer-based, partially materialized, and governed by layered licenses.
HoneyBee 报告了 248.0 万条由 Llama-4 Scout 构造的图文与纯文本 SFT 记录，覆盖 2.8 万张图像和 35 万个问题；公开版本以来源指针为主，当前仅部分物化，并受多层许可约束。
why: It turns context choice, auxiliary captions, image diversity, questions per image, and traces per question into separately tested construction variables, giving the open-release recipe track a concrete multimodal scaling study with visible audit boundaries.
inclusion_reason: Provides a controlled multimodal data-recipe study and a large pointer-preserving release with explicit teacher, source-selection, question/trace scaling, and licensing boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language reasoning datasets are often described by a total row count, even though their effective training signal depends on several separable quantities: which image/question contexts are chosen, how many distinct images appear, how many questions are attached to each image, how many solutions are sampled for each question, and whether the target trace explicitly describes the visual evidence. HoneyBee asks which of these choices improve supervised vision-language reasoning when model scale, training, and evaluation are held comparatively stable.

The paper also confronts a release-design problem. The final records combine material derived from ViRL with re-annotated OpenThoughts3 questions, but some upstream images and questions are not redistributed. A reusable HoneyBee record is therefore not just a question and rationale. It is a lineage-bearing object with q_source, q_id, an optional image path, an optional question, and a generated cot; some rows must be reconstructed from upstream datasets before they become trainable examples.

The study is relevant to data construction because it distinguishes recipe evidence from data-quality evidence. Downstream gains can show that one mixture trained the tested PLMs better than another, but they cannot certify every generated question, caption, rationale, answer, or upstream right. The central audit question is consequently whether the public rows preserve enough provenance, verification state, and version information for another group to reproduce or safely adapt the recipe.

视觉语言推理数据集常被压缩成一个总行数，但实际训练信号由多个可分离因素决定：选择哪些图像—问题上下文、包含多少张不同图像、每张图像配置多少个问题、每个问题采样多少条解答，以及目标轨迹是否明确描述视觉证据。HoneyBee 试图在模型规模、训练设置和评测条件相对受控的情况下，判断这些选择中哪些真正有利于监督式视觉语言推理。

论文同时暴露了开放发布的结构性难题。最终记录既含有基于 ViRL 构造的内容，也含有重新标注的 OpenThoughts3 问题，但部分上游图像和问题并未再次分发。因此，可复用的 HoneyBee 样本并不只是“问题加推理过程”，而是带来源链的对象：它包含 q_source、q_id、可空的图像路径、可空的问题以及生成的 cot；有些记录只有在重新获取上游数据后才能成为完整训练样本。

这项工作对数据构造研究的重要性在于，它把“配方有效”与“逐条数据正确”区分开来。下游增益只能说明某种混合数据在论文所测 PLM 上更有效，不能证明每个新问题、图像描述、推理过程、最终答案或上游权利都已通过认证。因此，审计重点是公开记录是否保留了足够的来源、验证状态和版本信息，使第三方能够复现或安全改造这套配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
HoneyBee uses one fixed teacher, Llama-4 Scout, to turn data design into a controlled search. The authors first compare six candidate context sources under 50K-example caps, decontaminate exact evaluation-image matches with pHash, generate CoTs with the same teacher, and train PLM-3B and PLM-8B under the same evaluation protocol. ViRL gives the best average result among the tested sources; mixing the top sources does not improve on it. The final construction therefore starts from ViRL rather than treating all available multimodal corpora as equally useful.

The recipe then scales three axes separately. It increases unique images by taking progressively larger subsets, increases questions per image by generating new questions conditioned on an image and seed question, and increases solutions per image/question pair by sampling additional CoTs. Caption-and-solve is the selected perceptual intervention: Llama-4 Scout generates a detailed caption independently of the solution, and the two texts are concatenated so that the student learns to emit caption then reasoning.

For the 39K original ViRL tuples, the teacher samples 16 CoTs and only traces whose final answer matches the known answer survive, leaving roughly 400K instances. For each image the pipeline creates 14 new questions, so the target is 15 questions including the original. Each new question receives four CoTs; an answer occurring at least three times becomes a proxy label, and only matching CoTs are retained, yielding roughly one million more instances. Adding captions produces the vision-language subset. The paper's exact table reports 1.440M vision-language plus 1.040M text-only records, or 2.480M total, around 28K unique images and 350K unique questions.

The text-only component is not copied unchanged from OpenThoughts3. Its 1.04M questions are re-annotated with Llama-4 Scout so the generator is consistent across modalities. The public dataset nevertheless preserves upstream pointers, so recipe-level consistency does not imply a self-contained release.

HoneyBee 固定使用 Llama-4 Scout 作为教师，把数据设计转化为受控搜索。作者先把六个候选上下文来源各自限制在最多 5 万条，用 pHash 去除与评测集完全相同的图像，再由同一教师生成 CoT，并在统一协议下训练 PLM-3B 与 PLM-8B。ViRL 在这些候选来源中取得最高平均结果，而混合排名靠前的来源并未超过它。因此，最终构造从 ViRL 出发，而不是把所有可用多模态语料视为同等有效。

随后，配方分别放大三个维度：通过扩大子集增加不同图像数；根据图像和种子问题生成新问题，从而提高每图问题数；为同一图像—问题对采样更多 CoT，从而提高每题解答数。感知增强方面选用 caption-and-solve：Llama-4 Scout 分别生成详细图像描述和解题过程，再把两段文本拼接，使学生模型学习先描述图像、再完成推理。

对 3.9 万个原始 ViRL 三元组，教师各采样 16 条 CoT，只保留最终答案与已知答案一致的轨迹，得到约 40 万条记录。每张图像再生成 14 个新问题，与原问题合计 15 个；每个新问题采样四条 CoT，至少三条给出相同答案时才形成代理标签，并只保留与该代理答案一致的轨迹，由此再得到约 100 万条。加入图像描述后形成视觉语言子集。论文表格给出的精确拆分是 144.0 万条视觉语言记录和 104.0 万条纯文本记录，总计 248.0 万条，涉及约 2.8 万张不同图像和 35 万个不同问题。

纯文本部分并非原样复制 OpenThoughts3。其 104 万个问题全部由 Llama-4 Scout 重新生成解答，使跨模态教师保持一致。不过，公开数据仍保留上游指针，因此生成配方的一致性并不意味着发布物本身完全自包含。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction study begins with ViRL, Math-LLaVA, R1-OneVision, ThinkLite-VL-Hard, LLaVA-CoT, and MMK12. For each source, the authors remove records whose images exactly match validation images according to pHash and sample at most 50K contexts. Llama-4 Scout, described as a 109B-total/17B-active MoE model, generates the comparison CoTs. PLM-3B and PLM-8B are then fully fine-tuned and scored with an identical boxed-answer prompt and greedy decoding across MathVerse, MathVista, MathVision, MMMU-Pro, and We-Math. This downstream average is used for hill-climbing over recipe choices, not as a per-record validator.

After ViRL is selected, several interventions test perception and problem-solving changes. Visual perturbation, synthetic text-rich images, filters for questions solvable without an image or with only a caption, distractor insertion, long-trace selection, and uniform-difficulty sampling do not beat the baseline in the reported comparison. Independently generated captions concatenated with independently generated solutions improve the average; mixing re-annotated OpenThoughts3 data improves it further. These are empirical choices within the reported setup, not universal guarantees.

The final vision-language pipeline has two answer contracts. Existing ViRL questions carry source answers: 16 teacher traces are sampled per tuple, their final answers are extracted, and traces that do not match the source answer are discarded. Newly synthesized questions lack gold answers: four traces are sampled, an answer must appear at least three times, and matching traces are kept. Because one model produces all four candidates, this is self-consistency filtering rather than independent verification. The paper does not disclose generation temperature, top-p, maximum generation length, request seeds, rejected outputs, or extraction logs.

Image captions are generated once per image independently of the solutions, then prepended to each retained solution. OpenThoughts3's 1.04M questions are re-annotated by the same teacher. The released schema has five fields—q_source, q_id, image_path, question, and cot—with q_source values observed as OpenThoughts3, ViRL, or Ours. Null question or image fields signal that upstream material must be resolved separately.

For model training, the supplement reports full-parameter PLM fine-tuning for five epochs. The archived 3B configuration pins seed 777, 6,075 steps, learning rate 4e-5, 607 warmup steps, and parameters consistent with a global batch of 2,048. The paper's GRPO experiment is downstream use: it trains for one epoch on a separate verified multimodal dataset with rule-based terminal rewards. It should not be read as a reward annotation contained in HoneyBee.

构造研究从 ViRL、Math-LLaVA、R1-OneVision、ThinkLite-VL-Hard、LLaVA-CoT 和 MMK12 六个来源开始。作者先用 pHash 去除图像与验证集完全相同的记录，再从每个来源最多采样 5 万个上下文。论文将 Llama-4 Scout 描述为总参数 109B、激活参数 17B 的 MoE 模型，并用它生成对比实验所需 CoT。随后对 PLM-3B 和 PLM-8B 做全参数微调，使用统一的 boxed-answer 提示和贪心解码，在 MathVerse、MathVista、MathVision、MMMU-Pro 与 We-Math 上评分。这个下游平均分用于搜索配方选择，不是逐条样本验证器。

选定 ViRL 后，作者测试多类感知与解题干预。视觉扰动、合成富文本图像、过滤“不看图也能答”或“只看描述即可答”的问题、增加干扰项、偏向长轨迹以及均匀难度采样，在报告的对比中都没有超过基线。相反，分别生成图像描述与解题过程后再拼接能够提高平均结果，加入重新标注的 OpenThoughts3 后又进一步提高。这些结论只是在论文设置中的实证选择，不是普适保证。

最终视觉语言流水线包含两种答案契约。原始 ViRL 问题带有来源答案：每个三元组采样 16 条教师轨迹，抽取最终答案，并丢弃与来源答案不一致的轨迹。新生成问题没有金标答案：每题采样四条轨迹，至少三条必须给出同一答案，随后只保留与该答案一致的轨迹。由于四个候选都来自同一个模型，这属于自一致性过滤，而非独立验证。论文没有披露数据生成时的温度、top-p、最大生成长度、请求随机种子、被拒输出或答案抽取日志。

图像描述按图像独立生成，再加到每条保留解答之前；OpenThoughts3 的 104 万个问题也由同一教师重新标注。公开模式只有五个字段：q_source、q_id、image_path、question 和 cot；官方 Dataset Viewer 中可见的 q_source 值为 OpenThoughts3、ViRL 和 Ours。问题或图像字段为空，意味着使用者需要另行解析上游内容。

模型训练方面，补充材料报告对 PLM 做五轮全参数微调。归档仓库中的 3B 配置固定随机种子 777、6075 个训练步、4e-5 学习率和 607 个预热步，并对应全局批量 2048。论文中的 GRPO 属于下游使用实验：它在另一个可验证多模态数据集上训练一轮并采用规则式终局奖励，不能被误解为 HoneyBee 自带的奖励标注。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence for the construction claims comes from the official CVPR paper and supplement. Table 2 compares six context sources under the controlled PLM-3B/8B setup; ViRL is highest at 40.1 average accuracy and MMK12 lowest at 36.0. Table 3 reports caption-and-solve at 41.4 versus 40.1 for the original data, and the text-only mixture at 43.1. Figure 3 reports monotonic improvement over the tested image, question, and CoT scaling points. These results support the tested recipe decisions, although source selection and intervention effects could vary with other teachers, students, or evaluation sets.

Table 4 supplies the non-rounded composition: 2,480K total instances, 1,440K vision-language, 1,040K text-only, 28K unique images, and 350K unique questions. The paper rounds these to 2.5M, 1.5M, and 1M in prose. The official Hugging Face dataset confirms that a train release exists with the five stated fields, but its Dataset Viewer conversion is partial: at revision 3ac2b01b117893adcd02c62f7e04bd500b2a5240, it materializes 1,360,000 rows and estimates 2,463,128. This does not reconcile exactly to Table 4, so the Card keeps paper and live-artifact counts separate.

Model results are evidence of utility, not a correctness certificate. The paper reports that HoneyBee-trained PLMs improve over their bases and selected competitors, and that performance continues improving across 50K, 250K, and 2.5M training subsets. It also reports a test-time shared-caption experiment on MathVista with 64 samples at temperature 0.7: reusing the first caption reduces the tested token/FLOP total by 73% while giving similar performance. Neither result validates every released rationale.

The official repository corroborates a narrower reproducibility surface. At archived commit 987a1cba97a496c3f9ad43ade65c4504a4428ce0, it contains evaluation code, three PLM YAML configurations, and the license, but no data-generation implementation, rejected-candidate logs, trained HoneyBee checkpoints, or formal release. The README explicitly says trained VLMs are not planned for release. The 3B YAML provides concrete SFT settings, while generation sampling remains unknown.

The supplement directly acknowledges that final-answer filtering does not settle reasoning faithfulness. It reports a GPT-5.1-mini judgment that 80% of HoneyBee-8B CoTs on MathVista were faithful. That is a model-judged, model-output evaluation on one benchmark—not a human audit of the released training corpus—and it implies that final-answer agreement can coexist with unfaithful reasoning.

构造结论最强的证据来自 CVPR 正式论文和补充材料。表 2 在受控的 PLM-3B/8B 设置下比较六个上下文来源，ViRL 的平均准确率最高，为 40.1，MMK12 最低，为 36.0。表 3 中，caption-and-solve 为 41.4，原始数据为 40.1，加入纯文本数据的方案为 43.1。图 3 显示，在论文测试的图像数、问题数和 CoT 数各个缩放点上，性能均随规模增加。这些结果支持论文选择的配方，但不同教师、学生模型或评测集可能得到不同排序。

表 4 给出未经四舍五入的组成：总计 248.0 万条，其中视觉语言 144.0 万条、纯文本 104.0 万条，包含 2.8 万张不同图像和 35 万个不同问题。正文则将它们近似写成 250 万、150 万和 100 万。官方 Hugging Face 数据集证实了单一 train 发布及五字段模式，但 Dataset Viewer 的转换不完整：在修订 3ac2b01b117893adcd02c62f7e04bd500b2a5240 上，已物化 136 万行，估算总行数为 2,463,128。这个数字无法与表 4 完全对齐，因此本卡片分别保留论文计数和当前公开物计数。

模型结果是用途证据，不是正确性证书。论文显示，使用 HoneyBee 训练的 PLM 优于相应基础模型和部分对比模型，并且从 5 万、25 万到 250 万训练子集时性能继续上升。论文还在 MathVista 上测试了共享图像描述的推理时方案：温度 0.7、每题采样 64 次时，后续解答复用第一条图像描述，在相近性能下将所测 token/FLOP 总量减少 73%。这两项结果都不能验证每一条公开推理过程。

官方仓库只能支撑更有限的复现范围。归档提交 987a1cba97a496c3f9ad43ade65c4504a4428ce0 包含评测代码、三个 PLM YAML 配置和许可文件，但没有数据生成实现、拒绝样本日志、HoneyBee 训练后模型或正式发行版。README 明确表示不计划发布训练后的 VLM。3B YAML 给出了具体 SFT 设置，而生成采样参数仍未知。

补充材料也直接承认，最终答案过滤并不能解决推理忠实性问题。作者用 GPT-5.1-mini 评判 HoneyBee-8B 在 MathVista 上的 CoT，报告 80% 忠实。这只是对单个基准上的模型输出进行模型裁判，不是对公开训练语料的人类审计；同时它说明，最终答案一致仍可能伴随不忠实推理。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
HoneyBee's useful novelty is the experimental decomposition of multimodal reasoning data. Rather than treating “more examples” as one operation, it measures source context, unique-image coverage, questions per image, traces per question, and caption assistance as different construction decisions. That decomposition matters because 16 solutions for one question and one solution for 16 distinct images have the same row count but very different diversity and verification properties.

The selected caption-and-solve variant also makes the supervision object explicit: the target trace is a concatenation of an independently generated detailed caption and an independently generated solution. The paper tests alternative ways to condition caption and solution generation and finds this separable version strongest in its setup. At test time, that factorization enables reuse of one caption across multiple solution samples, connecting a data-format decision to an inference-efficiency experiment.

Another contribution is negative evidence. Several plausible interventions—visual perturbations, synthetic text-rich images, removing questions solvable without the image, adding distractors, selecting long traces, and balancing difficulty—do not improve the controlled average. Publishing these comparisons helps prevent the construction track from turning every intuitive filter into an assumed quality improvement.

None of the components is a universal verifier. Teacher distillation, self-consistency voting, exact-image hashing, pointer-based packaging, and caption-first targets all have precedents. The contribution is the controlled combination and the reported large-scale release, together with enough detail to distinguish known-answer filtering from proxy-answer filtering. The public artifact remains weaker than the conceptual recipe because it omits generation logs and a complete reconstruction manifest.

HoneyBee 最有价值的新意是把多模态推理数据拆成可实验比较的因素。它没有把“增加样本”视为单一操作，而是分别测量上下文来源、不同图像覆盖、每图问题数、每题轨迹数以及图像描述辅助。这样的拆分很重要，因为“同一问题生成 16 条解答”和“16 张不同图像各生成一条解答”具有相同行数，却对应完全不同的多样性与验证属性。

被选中的 caption-and-solve 变体也明确了监督对象：目标轨迹由独立生成的详细图像描述和独立生成的解题过程拼接而成。论文比较了图像描述与解题过程的不同条件关系，发现这种可分离方案在其设置中最强。推理时，这种分解还允许多个解答共用一次图像描述，把数据格式选择与推理效率实验连接起来。

另一项贡献是负面证据。视觉扰动、合成富文本图像、删除“不看图也能答”的问题、增加干扰项、筛选长轨迹以及平衡难度等看似合理的干预，在受控平均结果中并未带来提升。公开这些比较有助于避免在数据构造研究中把每一种直觉式过滤都默认成质量提升。

这些组件都不是通用验证器。教师蒸馏、自一致性投票、精确图像哈希、指针式发布以及描述优先目标均有先例。论文的贡献在于受控组合、规模化发布，以及明确区分“已知答案过滤”和“代理答案过滤”。但公开物仍弱于概念配方，因为它没有提供生成日志和完整重建清单。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The answer filters are terminal and teacher-dependent. A known ViRL answer can reject a correct alternative form if extraction or normalization fails, while four samples from one Llama-4 Scout instance are not independent voters. Three agreeing traces can share the same visual hallucination, algebraic mistake, or answer-parser artifact. Conversely, a valid minority answer can be discarded. No released per-step labels establish that the caption is grounded or the intermediate reasoning causes the final answer.

The public release is only partly self-contained. Dataset Viewer examples show rows in which question or image_path is null, because q_source and q_id point to OpenThoughts3 or ViRL. Reuse therefore depends on independently obtaining compatible upstream revisions, joining identifiers correctly, and observing upstream licenses and deletion requests. The release does not provide a record-level source revision, checksum, license, verification decision, teacher request, or rejected candidates.

Decontamination is narrow. The paper removes evaluation images that exactly match source images under pHash; it does not report exhaustive checks for crops, rotations, screenshots, derived diagrams, semantically equivalent questions, answer leakage, or text-only benchmark overlap. Five benchmarks guide recipe hill-climbing, so their scores are validation evidence rather than untouched final-test evidence; five additional evaluation sets are introduced after the final construction, but a complete overlap audit is still unknown.

Counts and versions require care. The paper table says 2,480,000 records, while the current partial Hub conversion estimates 2,463,128 and materializes 1,360,000. The official dataset revision and GitHub commit can be pinned, but no release manifest explains the difference or binds paper rows, source pointers, generation code, and model revisions. The GitHub repository is archived, has two commits, and publishes no trained HoneyBee checkpoint.

Licensing is layered rather than settled by the cc-by-nc-4.0 dataset tag. The repository license says the data are CC-BY-NC, Llama-4 outputs remain subject to the Llama 4 license—including its model-naming condition—and third-party content remains governed by its own terms. The exact rights for every upstream image/question pair and the effect of pointer reconstruction require separate review.

Finally, the paper's own faithfulness check is limited: GPT-5.1-mini judges 80% of HoneyBee-8B MathVista CoTs faithful. This is neither a human corpus audit nor proof about the released teacher traces. A Dataset Viewer spot check also found a trace that says no interval satisfies an inequality but then boxes an interval. That single observation demonstrates a possible failure mode only; it must not be extrapolated into a prevalence estimate.

答案过滤只检查终局结果，而且依赖教师。对带金标的 ViRL 问题，如果答案抽取或归一化失败，正确的等价表达也可能被拒绝；对新问题，同一个 Llama-4 Scout 生成的四个样本并不是独立投票者。三条一致轨迹可能共享同一视觉幻觉、代数错误或解析器伪影；相反，有效的少数答案可能被删除。公开数据没有逐步标签来证明图像描述确实有视觉依据，或中间推理真正导致最终答案。

公开版本只在部分意义上自包含。Dataset Viewer 示例中可见 question 或 image_path 为空的记录，因为 q_source 与 q_id 只指向 OpenThoughts3 或 ViRL。使用者必须自行取得兼容的上游修订、正确连接标识符，并遵守上游许可和删除请求。发布物没有为每条记录提供来源修订、校验和、许可、验证决定、教师请求或被拒候选。

去污染范围较窄。论文使用 pHash 删除与评测图像完全相同的来源图像，但没有报告对裁剪、旋转、截图、派生图表、语义等价问题、答案泄漏或纯文本基准重叠的穷尽检查。五个基准用于配方爬山搜索，因此它们的分数属于验证证据，而不是完全未接触的最终测试；最终构造后又加入五个评测集，但完整重叠审计仍未知。

计数和版本需要谨慎处理。论文表格给出 2,480,000 条，而当前 Hub 的部分转换估算为 2,463,128 条，实际物化 1,360,000 条。官方数据修订和 GitHub 提交可以固定，但没有发行清单解释差值，也没有把论文行、来源指针、生成代码和模型修订绑定在一起。GitHub 仓库已归档，只有两个提交，也没有发布训练后的 HoneyBee 检查点。

许可是分层的，不能由数据页上的 cc-by-nc-4.0 标签一笔带过。仓库许可声明数据采用 CC-BY-NC，Llama-4 输出仍受 Llama 4 许可约束，其中包括模型命名条件；第三方内容继续受各自条款约束。每个上游图像—问题对的具体权利，以及通过指针重建后产生的义务，都需要另行核查。

最后，论文自己的忠实性检查也有限：GPT-5.1-mini 将 HoneyBee-8B 在 MathVista 上 80% 的 CoT 判为忠实。这既不是人类对全语料的审计，也不能直接证明公开教师轨迹的质量。Dataset Viewer 抽查还发现一条轨迹，正文先说没有任何区间满足不等式，随后却框出一个区间。这个单例只能说明故障模式可能存在，不能外推为发生率。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, HoneyBee is a useful case study in allocating a multimodal data budget. Its controlled comparisons suggest that source selection can matter as much as adding more corpora, that unique images, questions per image, and traces per question should be reported separately, and that auxiliary captions can be treated as an explicit target component. A derivative study can reuse this factorial framing even if it chooses a different teacher, student family, or domain.

The release can support SFT research after reconstruction. The five-field schema and q_source/q_id identifiers make it possible to preserve source lineage while joining upstream OpenThoughts3 and ViRL content. Researchers can compare caption-plus-solution targets with solution-only targets, test whether same-teacher majority filtering helps, or study scale along the three axes. Such experiments should pin Hub revision 3ac2b01b117893adcd02c62f7e04bd500b2a5240, record the upstream revisions used to resolve pointers, and report the number of successfully reconstructed rows rather than assuming the 2.5M headline.

The data can also serve as an SFT cold start before a separately specified RLVR stage, as the paper demonstrates with one GRPO round. That use requires keeping the objects distinct: HoneyBee contains supervised caption/solution targets; it does not contain the GRPO policy rollouts or terminal reward logs. Evaluation reuse is supported by the repository's scripts for ten datasets, but the README says the scripts initially target base PLMs without CoT and may require adaptation for other Hugging Face models.

A responsible derivative should add an immutable shard manifest, per-row upstream source/revision/license, answer-extraction results, retained and rejected candidate IDs, and independent audits for proxy-answer correctness and visual grounding. It should extend pHash exact matching with near-duplicate image and semantic question/answer checks, maintain upstream deletion handling, and separate paper-table counts from live repository counts. Those additions turn HoneyBee's experimental recipe into a more auditable production pipeline.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 赛道而言，HoneyBee 是分配多模态数据预算的典型案例。受控比较表明，来源选择可能与增加更多语料同样重要；不同图像数、每图问题数和每题轨迹数应分别报告；辅助图像描述也可作为明确的目标组成部分。即使换用其他教师、学生模型或领域，后续研究仍可复用这种因子化框架。

完成重建后，公开数据可用于 SFT 研究。五字段模式和 q_source/q_id 标识符允许在连接 OpenThoughts3 与 ViRL 上游内容时保留来源链。研究者可以比较“图像描述加解答”和“仅解答”目标，测试同教师多数过滤的作用，或分别研究三个缩放维度。此类实验应固定 Hub 修订 3ac2b01b117893adcd02c62f7e04bd500b2a5240，记录用于解析指针的上游修订，并报告成功重建的实际行数，而不是直接采用“250 万”标题数字。

论文还展示了把该数据作为 SFT 冷启动、再进入独立 RLVR 阶段的用法，但必须区分数据对象：HoneyBee 提供监督式图像描述与解题目标，不包含 GRPO 的策略 rollout 或终局奖励日志。仓库提供十个数据集的评测脚本，不过 README 说明脚本最初面向不生成 CoT 的基础 PLM，其他 Hugging Face 模型可能需要适配。

更负责任的衍生版本应增加不可变分片清单、逐条上游来源/修订/许可、答案抽取结果、保留与拒绝候选标识，以及对代理答案正确性和视觉依据的独立审计。它还应在 pHash 精确匹配之外加入图像近重复与问题/答案语义重叠检查，处理上游删除请求，并把论文表格计数与当前仓库计数分开报告。这些补充能把 HoneyBee 的实验配方推进为更可审计的生产流水线。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Table 4 before repeating the rounded headline: it reports 2.480M total records, split into 1.440M vision-language and 1.040M text-only. Keep its 28K-image and 350K-question diversity counts separate from repeated-trace row counts.
  • The answer contracts differ: existing ViRL questions use known answers to filter 16 traces, whereas generated questions use a three-of-four proxy over four same-teacher traces. Caption-and-solve concatenates an independently generated caption and solution.
  • The schema preserves pointers: q_source and q_id may be present while question or image_path is null. Reconstruction can require OpenThoughts3 or ViRL and their licenses.
  • The checked Hub conversion is partial: 1,360,000 materialized rows and 2,463,128 estimated rows. Do not substitute this estimate for the paper count.
  • pHash covers exact validation-image matches only. Benchmark gains and the 80% GPT-5.1-mini faithfulness judgment of HoneyBee-8B MathVista outputs do not certify individual released records or exclude semantic contamination.
  • The archived repository publishes evaluation scripts and PLM configs, not the generation pipeline, a formal release, or trained HoneyBee checkpoints; the rights surface combines CC-BY-NC, Llama 4 terms, and upstream terms.

• 引用标题约数前先看表 4：总量是 248.0 万条，其中视觉语言 144.0 万条、纯文本 104.0 万条；2.8 万张图像和 35 万个问题的多样性计数应与重复轨迹行数分开。
  • 两种答案契约不同：原始 ViRL 问题用已知答案过滤 16 条轨迹；新问题则对同一教师的四条轨迹采用至少三票一致的代理答案。caption-and-solve 拼接独立生成的描述与解答。
  • 发布模式保留来源指针：即使有 q_source 和 q_id，question 或 image_path 仍可能为空；重建可能依赖 OpenThoughts3、ViRL 及其许可。
  • 核查时 Hub 只完成部分转换：物化 1,360,000 行，估算 2,463,128 行。不要用该估算替代论文计数。
  • pHash 只处理完全相同的验证图像。基准增益和 GPT-5.1-mini 对 HoneyBee-8B MathVista 输出作出的“80% 忠实”判断，都不能认证逐条公开记录或排除语义污染。
  • 归档仓库提供评测脚本和 PLM 配置，不提供生成流水线、正式发行版或训练后检查点；权利边界同时涉及 CC-BY-NC、Llama 4 条款和上游条款。
